options.source:
flowchart LR
  subgraph CI [Continuous Integration]
    direction TB
    plan[Plan] --> build[Build]
    build --> review[Review]
    subgraph Checks [Quality Gates]
      direction LR
      lint[Lint] --> test[Test] --> scan[Scan]
    end
    build --> Checks
  end
  start([Commit]) --> CI
  CI --> ship([Ship])

sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  title Order Checkout
  box rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.14) Edge
    actor User
    participant Web
  end
  participant API
  participant DB
  User->>+Web: Place order
  Web->>+API: POST /orders
  API->>+DB: INSERT order
  alt Payment OK
    DB-->>-API: order_id
    Note over API: Emit OrderCreated
    API-->>-Web: 201 Created
  else Declined
    API-->>Web: 402 Payment Required
  end
  Web-->>-User: Show receipt

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Pending
  Pending --> Validating : submit
  state Validating <<choice>>
  Validating --> Processing : valid
  Validating --> Cancelled : invalid
  state Processing {
    [*] --> Authorizing
    Authorizing --> Captured : paid
    --
    [*] --> Reserving
    Reserving --> Allocated : in stock
  }
  Processing --> Shipped : ready
  Shipped --> [*]
  Cancelled --> [*]
  note right of Pending : Awaits customer confirmation
  classDef ok fill:#14532D,stroke:#22C55E,color:#DCFCE7
  class Shipped ok
